entities.summary: Tyler Wotherspoon is a Canadian professional ice hockey defenceman who is currently a free agent. He last played for Barys Astana of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected in the second round, 57th overall, by the Calgary Flames in the 2011 NHL entry draft.
